_note: 學習路徑內容建置第11批 #4／6：讓步連接詞 although／though／even though（eng.t_mid.conj.subordinate-concession，會考級／中階）。它們是從屬連接詞，引導一個子句（主詞＋動詞）表讓步／對比，且在標準英語中不與 but 並用（擇一）；even though 較 although 強調，though 較口語且可放句尾；despite／in spite of 後接名詞不接子句。防第二正解＝讓步題用 still/anyway 鎖對比（排除 because 的因果讀法）、不與 because/so 混；句尾位置只有 though 可用。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix cnc_）。

units.can_do: 我能用 although／though／even though 引導一個子句（主詞＋動詞）表達讓步／對比，知道它們在標準英語中不與 but 並用、even though 較強調、though 可放句尾，而 despite／in spite of 後面要接名詞不接子句。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'although', 'though' and 'even though' are subordinating conjunctions that introduce a clause (subject + verb) showing concession or contrast: 'Although it was raining, we went out'.
claims.verification_ref: although/though/even though 從屬連接詞引導子句表讓步；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: In standard English we do not use 'but' in the same sentence as although/though/even though — we choose one, not both: 'Although it was late, we stayed' (not 'Although it was late, but we stayed').
claims.verification_ref: 標準英語 although 等不與 but 並用，擇一；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'even though' is a stronger, more emphatic form of 'although'; 'though' is more informal and can also come at the end of a sentence: 'It was hard. I liked it, though'.
claims.verification_ref: even though 較強調、though 較口語且可放句尾；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: These conjunctions are followed by a clause, unlike 'despite' and 'in spite of', which are followed by a noun or -ing form: 'Although he was tired' (clause) vs 'Despite his tiredness' (noun).
claims.verification_ref: although 等接子句；despite/in spite of 接名詞或 -ing；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 'although', 'though' and 'even though' join two contrasting ideas. They start a clause (subject + verb) and lead to a result that is surprising: Although it was raining, we still went out.
teach.zh_hint: although、though、even though 把兩個『互相對比』的意思連起來。它們引導一個子句（主詞＋動詞），帶出一個『出乎意料』的結果：Although it was raining, we still went out.（雖然在下雨，我們還是出門了。）

teach.body: Although she was tired, she finished her homework.
teach.zh_hint: 雖然她很累，還是把作業寫完了。

teach.body: Important: in standard English, 'although/though/even though' are not used together with 'but' in the same sentence; you choose only one. Say 'Although it was late, we stayed', not 'Although it was late, but we stayed'.
teach.zh_hint: 重要：在標準英語裡，although／though／even though 不和 but『同時』用，兩個只能選一個。要說 Although it was late, we stayed——不說 Although it was late, but we stayed。

teach.body: Even though the test was hard, he passed it.
teach.zh_hint: 即使考試很難，他還是通過了。even though＝語氣更強的 although。

teach.body: 'even though' is stronger than 'although'; 'though' is more informal and can also go at the end: The room was small. I liked it, though. Also, 'despite' and 'in spite of' are followed by a noun, not a clause: Despite the rain (noun) vs. Although it was raining (clause).
teach.zh_hint: even though 比 although 更強調；though 較口語，還可以放在句尾：The room was small. I liked it, though.（房間很小，不過我喜歡。）另外，despite／in spite of 後面接『名詞』不接子句：Despite the rain（名詞）對比 Although it was raining（子句）。

teach.body: Though it was expensive, we bought the gift.
teach.zh_hint: 雖然很貴，我們還是買了這份禮物。

practice.stem: 填入正確的連接詞：____ it was very cold, we still went swimming.（雖然很冷，我們還是去游泳了）

distractor_rationales.Because: Because 表原因；但『很冷』不是去游泳的原因（有 still＝對比），意思不合。
distractor_rationales.So: So 表結果『所以』，不引導前面的讓步子句。
distractor_rationales.And: And 只是並列『而且』，表達不出『雖然…還是…』的對比。

practice.feedback: 表『雖然…還是…』（對比）用 Although：Although it was cold, we still went swimming。

practice.answer: Although the movie was long, I enjoyed it.
options: Although the movie was long, I enjoyed it.
Although the movie was long, but I enjoyed it.
Although the movie was long, so I enjoyed it.
Because the movie was long, but I enjoyed it.

distractor_rationales.Although the movie was long, but I enjoy: 標準英語 although 不與 but 並用，擇一即可。
distractor_rationales.Although the movie was long, so I enjoye: although 不與 so 並用；so 表結果，意思也不合。
distractor_rationales.Because the movie was long, but I enjoye: Because＋but 不並用，且『很長』不是喜歡的原因。

practice.feedback: although 不與 but 並用：Although the movie was long, I enjoyed it。

practice.stem: 填入句尾正確的詞：The food was cold. It tasted good, ____.（食物冷了，不過很好吃）

distractor_rationales.although: although 要放在子句前面引導子句，不能單獨放句尾。
distractor_rationales.even though: even though 也要放在子句前面，不能單獨放句尾。
distractor_rationales.because: because 表原因，不能放句尾表『不過』。

practice.feedback: 放句尾表『不過』只能用 though：It tasted good, though。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞（後面是一個子句 he had a map）：____ he had a map, he still got lost.（儘管他有地圖，還是迷路了）

distractor_rationales.Despite: Despite 後面要接名詞（Despite the map），不能接子句 he had a map。
distractor_rationales.Because: Because 表原因；但有 still＝對比，『有地圖』不是迷路的原因。
distractor_rationales.So: So 表結果『所以』，不引導前面的讓步子句。

practice.feedback: 後面是子句、表讓步用 Even though：Even though he had a map, he still got lost。

practice.stem: 'Although we lost, we were happy.' 這句話表達的是？
practice.answer: 兩個對比的意思（輸了卻還是開心）
options: 兩個對比的意思（輸了卻還是開心）
一個原因（因為輸了所以開心）
一個額外補充（而且很開心）

distractor_rationales.一個原因（因為輸了所以開心）: 那是 because 的因果；although 表對比／讓步。
distractor_rationales.時間先後（先輸再開心）: although 不表時間順序；它表對比。
distractor_rationales.一個額外補充（而且很開心）: 那是 and 的並列；although 表對比。

practice.feedback: although 表讓步／對比：輸了『卻』還是開心。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: Although it was raining hard, we still enjoyed the trip.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：Although 有沒有寫對、有沒有誤加 but，raining hard／still enjoyed 有沒有寫對，逗號和句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。讓步子句（Although…）稍抬、逗號停頓、主句句尾下收；句尾 though 輕收。

lines.text: Although I was nervous, I gave the speech.
lines.intonation: Although I was nervous 稍抬、逗號停、I gave the speech 句尾下收

lines.text: The bag was heavy. I carried it home, though.
lines.intonation: I carried it home 連貫、句尾 though 輕收
